SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Morris County Chancery Division
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 25001933
DOCKET NO. F-010022-19
PLAINTIFF – CitiBank, N.A., as Trustee for the Chase Funding Mortgage Loan Asset-Backed Certificates, Series 2003-1
DEFENDANTS- Michael Parker; Beulah DeHeer Parker a/k/a Beulah De Heer Parker; Palisades Collection LLC; Midland Funding, LLC; United States of America
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Thursday THE 17th DAY OF September 2026
(Date may change subject to adjournments)
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Administration and Records Building, Court Street, Morristown, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Township of Mount Olive, County of Morris and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Lot: 16, Block: 4114
Dimensions: Approximately: .247 AC
Nearest Cross Street: Connelly Avenue
Plaintiff Upset Price: $773,164.24 and any additional sums ordered by the court
Occupancy Status: Unknown
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
22 Crestwood Circle, Budd Lake, NJ 07828
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Morris County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Pursuant to a tax search of 08/05/2026; 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 08/01/2026 $3,548.95 BILLED; $3,513.77 OPEN; SUBJECT TO POSTING; $35.18 PAID; ESTIMATED TAX BILL 2026 Qtr 4 Due: 11/01/2026 $3,612.24 OPEN Water: Mt. Olive Water + Sewer Dept. 204 Flanders-Drake Rd Mt. Olive, NJ 07828 973-691-0900 Unable to locate account. Account # is necessary to determine status. Please have seller provide evidence of all service at closing. Sewer: Mt. Olive Water + Sewer Dept. 204 Flanders-Drakes Rd Mt. Olive, NJ 07828 973-691-0900
Unable to locate account. Account # is necessary to determine status. Please have seller provide evidence of all servicing at closing. Information: Board of Health Well & Septic testing required on rentals only – ($75 Fee per). First American Title Insurance Company agrees to indemnify prior judgment in favor of James C. Dezao, filed 3/27/00, Case # J-059104-2000, in the amount of $49,677.66. Subject to Notice of lien in favor of County Oaks At Mount Olive Homeowners Association Inc. Recorded: 08/25/2009 Book: 21380 Page 601, Instrument No.: 2009069999, Amount: $2,945.00, and bidders are put on notice any and all past due homeowner’s association maintenance assessments are the responsibility of successful purchaser at sale. Deponent does not warrant the accuracy of this representation and herein makes no representation regarding the status of the title. Interested parties are advised to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether there exists any outstanding interests or amounts due.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Morris County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $599,631.30 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
JAMES M. GANNON
SHERIFF
DATED: August 6, 2026
Frenkel Lambert Weisman & Gordon, LLP
53 Gibson Street
Bayshore, NY 11706
973-325-8800
